violations.reason: Specification mismatch in compile_session_to_docx: requisites, preamble, actions, and signatures are hardcoded to Pt(12), title and command headers to Pt(13), doc_type to Pt(16), visas to Pt(10), and the approval mark to Pt(9), while table cell runs in t_elem set neither font.name nor font.size. This violates the client specification requirement for GOST R 7.0.97-2016 .docx formatting with Times New Roman 14pt (also declared as 'gost_font': 'Times New Roman 14pt' in data/templates/template_registry.json).

Specification mismatch in data/templates/template_registry.json: template TPL-01 ('Приказ о зачислении в ординатуру') defines required_tokens ['ORD_ID', 'FULL_NAME', 'SPECIALTY_CODE', 'SPECIALTY_NAME', 'BUDGET_TYPE', 'ORDER_NUMBER', 'DATE'], omitting a parameter for form of study (форма обучения) required alongside financing source by the client specification ('Доработка ГОСТ-шаблона приказа о зачислении (форма обучения и источник финансирования)').
